_about: Machine-readable rights for each top-level item in public/data. Details and evidence: docs/DATA_SOURCES.md and docs/LICENSING.md. `redistribution`: yes = may be redistributed as bundled; metadata-only = only facts, titles and links are stored; none = not included.

bible.license: Public domain (DRB 1899, Clementine Vulgate 1598, WEB, CPDV, Brenton 1851)
bible.notes: WEB trademark note kept; CPDV is a private translation without imprimatur

versification.json.notes: Confidence per mapping is in docs/VERSIFICATION.md

commentary.license: Public domain (Haydock, Challoner, Catena Aurea 1842, Glossa Ordinaria / Migne 1880)
commentary.attribution: CrossWire modules and SermonIndex; see DATA_SOURCES.md

library.license: Public domain translations (CCEL, 19th and early 20th century)
library.attribution: Each work's translator and print date in library/index.json
library.notes: Roman Catechism text is unproofread OCR

magisterium.license: References to Church documents; text not stored

lectionary.license: Citations only (USCCB references); Lectionary text not stored

usccb.license: Short daily excerpts shown with the USCCB copyright line and a link back
usccb.notes: Relies on the USCCB web usage terms

daily.license: App-written questions; quotes verified against sources where marked
daily.attribution: Quote authors named in each entry

dictionary.license: Public domain (Easton, Strong-type sources) as recorded in DATA_SOURCES.md

encyclopedia.license: Public domain: Catholic Encyclopedia 1913 (via New Advent)

maps.license: CC BY (OpenBible.info geocoding) and public-domain sources

media.license: Metadata and links only; audio and video belong to their publishers
media.attribution: Ascension, LibriVox (public domain recordings), YouTube channels as named

office.license: MIT (Divinum Officium data); psalm text Douay-Rheims (public domain)
office.notes: Weekly psalter, seasons, and (sancti-MM.json) saints and feasts by calendar date with collects and Matins lessons

original.license: Open lexicon and morphology data as recorded in DATA_SOURCES.md (STEPBible CC BY where used)

reference.license: Mixed: app-written outlines; Theographic Bible Metadata CC BY-SA 4.0 (reference/theographic); public-domain sources
reference.attribution: Theographic Bible Metadata by Robert Rouse (CC BY-SA 4.0); STEPBible TIPNR (CC BY 4.0)
reference.notes: reference/theographic is ShareAlike and must stay separate

resources.license: Links to pages written by others; titles and short notes only

saints.license: Public domain lives (Butler) and app-written index

topics.license: App-written topical index pointing to passages

apologetics.json.license: Directory of links to resources written by others; no answers are written by the app
apologetics.json.attribution: Publisher and author named per resource

art.json.license: Public-domain or open-access images with credit lines (Cleveland Museum CC0, The Met Open Access, Gallica Doré engravings)

art-more.json.license: Public-domain or open-access images with credit lines

manuscripts.json.license: Open-access (CC0) manuscript images from The Metropolitan Museum of Art

liturgy.attribution: The Divine Liturgy of St John Chrysostom, the Greek text with a rendering in English (Williams & Norgate, 1914), via the Internet Archive
liturgy.notes: OCR cleaned; rulers named in 1914 replaced by 'our rulers'. Not any Church's official text.

curriculum.license: Original text written for this project; quotes the Catechism and Scripture already shipped in the app
curriculum.notes: Not reviewed or approved by a bishop or diocese. Catechism paragraph numbers cite the Catechism of the Catholic Church.
